svg.title: Decoy and supported-cryptic dataset generation
svg.desc: Flowchart: SpliceAI donor inferences are filtered to protein-coding deep-intronic sites, split by CLIP signal at the site into decoys and cryptic sites, cryptic sites are kept when their canonical 5' splice site has CLIP signal, both classes are re-scored and filtered, and the results feed a site feature table and an intron feature table.

text.tspan: remove 3' SS 100 nt before BP region
